messages:
Claire (Product): Quick sync on enterprise audit roadmap82: customers keep asking for 'full retention for safety events' vs our cost-optimized lanes. Need a decision on acceptance criteria for pilot.
Owen (Security): From a controls perspective: full=auth, keystore ops, policy changes, legal-hold triggers. For model traces and prompt tokens, deterministic sampling + replay proof is acceptable if we can prove reproducibility.
Vik (Eng-Infra): Tech constraints: storing token traces at full volume multiplies storage and index load. Propose retention tiers exposed as 30/90/365 + "archive" for 7 years (cold). Also add a retention-cost calculator in console to show $/tenant.
Sam (Solutions): Customers want defendable numbers. Can we show unit economics: $/million tokens/day for each retention lane? Also need export SLA for evidence requests (under 4 hours for 30/90 lanes).
Riley (Legal): SOC2 auditors accept sampled evidence if sampling is deterministic and documented; ISO auditors may require additional integrity proofs. Contracts must specify: categories retained, sampling policy, export SLA, and key rotation responsibilities.
ComplianceBot: Created TASK-90001: "retention-cost-calculator + export-sla" assigned to @Vik.
Vik (Eng-Infra): Implementation sketch: add tenant field `retention_profile` and `sampling_seed` per-window. Hash-based sampling on request_id + seed yields reproducible selection. Indexing requirement: indexes on tenant + request_id + event_type to make exports reasonable. Estimate: 2 sprints.
Owen (Security): Evidence integrity: export bundles should include: manifest_version, time_window, sampling_seed, wrapped_export_key (BYOK), file_checksums, and platform_signature. For signatures prefer ED25519 for verifier simplicity.
Sam (Solutions): Demo flow: provision BYOK -> set tenant retention -> run legal-hold export -> verify manifest -> show replay for sampled traces. Also show cost estimator during sale.
Riley (Legal): Add contract clause template for pilot: default 90-day profile, optional paid archive, deterministic sampling disclosure + right to request full export (subject to costs/limits), key escrow only under subpoena.
Claire (Product): Pilot acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) Console+API to set retention_profile per tenant; 2) Retention cost estimator in UI; 3) Signed export bundles (BYOK) with verification guide; 4) Export SLA: <4h for 30/90, <24h for 365; 5) Auditor walkthrough with 2 pilots and documented reproducibility tests.
Vik (Eng-Infra): Note: export perf depends on index quality. Without request_id index, export for a tenant-day could take hours. Need to prioritize index work.
Owen (Security): Additions: manifest should record `hash_algorithm`, `sampling_hash_modulus` and `platform_signature_key_id` so external verifiers can reproduce sampling and verify signature.
Sam (Solutions): Also include a short "what to expect" one-pager: cost tradeoffs, latency impact, and steps to onboard BYOK. Sales likes that during RFPs.
Riley (Legal): I'll draft pilot addendum and minimal acceptable wording for auditors about sampling reproducibility. Also define responsibilities for key rotation and notification window.
Claire (Product): Action items: Vik -> TASK-90001 prototype + infra estimate; Owen -> short security spec for manifest + signature examples; Riley -> pilot contract addendum; Sam -> sales one-pager + demo script. We'll review Wednesday. Drop blockers here.
Vik (Eng-Infra): Example manifest (draft textual example): manifest_version:1 time_window:2026-06-01/2026-06-02 tenant:finserv-pilot sampling_seed:seed-20260601 sampling_policy:token_trace:5% auth:full wrapped_export_key:base64(...) files:[trace-20260601-0001.ndjson.gz] checksums:[sha256:...] signature:hex(...)
Owen (Security): That looks good. We'll pick ED25519 for platform signatures and AES-256-GCM for file encryption. Add `platform_signature_key_id`.
Claire (Product): Thanks all. If someone needs to push timelines, ping me directly. We'll convert this thread into a 1-pager for sales after Wednesday's review.
